issues: On the treatment_ended case 6a6b2d12811c1535451fde5d, Treatment Progress still surfaces 'Phase 1 — Done on Sep 08, 2026' (the augmentation surgery date). Non-blocking; on the current augmentation_in_progress case (a5) this misbehaviour is already fixed (Phase 1 shows ACTIVE without a spurious 'Done on' date), which was the primary regression in scope.

action_items: LOW/design: On treatment_ended (terminated during augmentation) cases, Treatment Progress still shows 'Phase 1 — Done on <augmentation surgery date>'. Since Phase 1 workflow never actually ran for these cases, consider changing to 'Not Started' or hiding the date row for terminated-during-augmentation cases (only affects readback, not workflow).

LOW/console noise: Persistent 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' warning fires on every case-detail render (also present in iter-310). Likely a stray whitespace/newline literal between JSX siblings in procedures/[id].tsx or AugmentationSection.tsx. Non-blocking but pollutes console.
critical_code_review_comments: AugmentationSection.tsx round-card pill logic correctly distinguishes 'Approved — Step 3 Review Pending' (step2 approved, awaiting owner Step 3 input), 'Step 3 — Awaiting Supervisor', 'Step 3 — Awaiting In-Charge', 'Rejected — Revise', 'Augmentation Complete', 'Reviewed — Graft Failed'. All six states observed live in this run.
app/procedures/augmentation-step3/[id].tsx correctly PREFILLS the form when reopened after a rejection (verified: bone_w=6.5, bone_h=10 retained). Good.

app/(tabs)/new-procedure.tsx augResumeId branch correctly (a) shows aug-resume-banner, (b) hides augmentation-question-section, (c) prefills patient/faculty/chief-complaint, (d) leaves payment+schedule empty, (e) renders all standard Phase 1 sections. Matches spec exactly.

procedures/[id].tsx timeline fix (~line 1502): on augmentation_in_progress with an unfinished augmentation round, Phase 1 now renders as ACTIVE without the erroneous 'Done on <future date>' text. Fix confirmed on case a5. However, on treatment_ended cases the same fix does not apply — Phase 1 still shows 'Done on <surgery date>' (see design_issues). Consider a broader guard: only render 'Done on X' when phase1_submitted_at (or completed_at) exists AND status has moved past Phase 1.

Two-step reject pattern (click aug-reject-btn → reason input appears → click again to confirm) works but the aug-reject-reason testID is not present in the DOM until AFTER the first click. Fine for humans; a test that queries aug-reject-reason before clicking would fail. Consider always rendering the input (visible only in an expanded state) so tests can pre-check its presence.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of primary scope (Step 3 form + reject/revise/approve chain + proceed-to-Phase-2 + resume banner/prefill/section-gating + timeline regression + 2-round terminated readback). Failed-decision UI + full Phase 2 completion + Phase 2 review card render NOT executed (see not_tested).
